_note: Cupra became a make in its own right in 2018, so these are the Cupra-badged cars only. Terraman and Terramar are both live rows for what is one car - Terramar is the correct spelling - so both carry the same engines until the duplicate is resolved. The five-cylinder Formentor (the Audi RS3 engine, a limited run) is listed as VZ5 because that badge is the car's identity - same rule as Corvette ZR1; a '2.5 TSI' alias covers the engine-badge spelling.
